responsibility: Core semantic implementation of the Objective-C front end. This file sits on top of the C/C++ parser hooks and owns Objective-C language actions such as building class/category/protocol and method/property trees, maintaining global maps of selectors and class names, resolving ivars/properties/protocols, checking and constructing message-send expressions, synthesizing property accessors, lowering Objective-C constructs like fast enumeration and @encode/@selector handling into GCC trees, issuing ObjC-specific diagnostics, and coordinating with the selected runtime via objc_runtime_hooks to trigger metadata and code-generation support.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the objc-act pair: this .c file defines the Objective-C front end’s executable semantic actions and language hooks, including class/method/property handling, message expressions, global selector/class maps, runtime-hook coordination, and tree node support. Unlike gcc/objc/objc-act.h, it is the defining translation unit rather than the shared declarations, macros, and inline accessors interface.
